_about: The ONE description of what each booking-request status means. Owned by khalil-back/contracts; src/booking-journey.js loads it and the frontend keeps a synced copy for documentation. Edit here only.

facts.holdsStock: its equipment counts against stock for upcoming events
facts.expires: the quote lapses automatically after its valid-days window
facts.showsPrices: the client may see the quote prices
facts.needsAdmin: an administrator must act (counted as 'needs attention')
facts.repriceable: an administrator may publish or republish a quote
facts.extendable: an administrator may extend or reactivate the quote
facts.awaitingClient: a quote is out and the client must accept or ask for changes (reminders go out here)
facts.canRecordDeposit: manual payments are recorded by administrators only; the deposit confirms the booking
facts.isBooked: a confirmed booking: its date is blocked, balance/refunds can be recorded, planning and the DJ set open
facts.cancellable: the booking may be cancelled (by an administrator, or by the client themselves) at any step before it is closed
facts.canNegotiate: client may propose prices or change services/equipment before acceptance or closure

pending.label: Submitted
pending.meaning: Client request received; no quote has been sent and the date is not reserved.
pending.whoActsNext: Administrator reviews and prepares a quote.

quoted.label: Waiting for client's decision
quoted.meaning: A quote is available and has an expiry.

accepted.label: Quote accepted
accepted.meaning: Client accepted the active quote. This alone does not confirm the booking.

changes_requested.label: Negotiation in progress
changes_requested.whoActsNext: Administrator reviews and sends a revised quote.

expired.label: Expired
expired.meaning: Quote validity ended before acceptance or deposit confirmation.

confirmed.label: Booking confirmed
confirmed.meaning: Deposit threshold was recorded and date/equipment checks passed.
confirmed.whoActsNext: Client and team can proceed with the confirmed event.

cancelled.label: Cancelled
cancelled.whoActsNext: Contact the team through existing account support channels.

branches._about: Steps that happen beside the main path. `decisions` are parallel: after the quote is ready the client either accepts it or asks for the best offer (both can happen, in either order). `cancel` can happen after ANY step of the path; it is shown branching off the step where it happened.
